name: – Gerben-Jan Gerbrandy – After § 94 – Am 53
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text: 94 a. In the interest of transparency of Parliament’s administrative budget, calls for full clarity to be provided on all mission expenses of administrative staff, with travel within and outside the Union amounting to more than EUR 732 000 in 2024; calls for the systematic and detailed disclosure of the purpose of each trip, the nature of the expenses incurred and the status of the participants, in order to provide the discharge authority with a comprehensive overview of the use of Union funds so that it can take informed decisions, and to ensure that taxpayers in the Member States also have access to this information;
